answer: Under a bonded-attestation rule, each agent locks a stake and submits one unique human credential to a public raven registry. When the same signal appears twice, both stakes are slashed, so a Sybil farmer must fund a fresh bond for every fake identity. Honest agents keep their footing on a narrow ledge only while credentials stay unique: cost to the attacker grows linearly with each new account, yet one duplicate can wipe the entire cluster.
